facts.fact: Benin's Cadre d'interopérabilité, a 32-page framework published by ASIN and instituted by décret n° 2020-209 of 18 March 2020, sets recommendations and referenced technical standards for interoperable government information systems (W3C SOAP/WSDL/XML/XSL/SVG/WCAG 2.0/CSS2/PNG, ISO 10918 JPEG, ISO/IEC 26300 ODF, MPEG4, RFC 1952, RFC 2306) and a catalogue of interoperability solutions; the PDF carries no publication date, so the decree date is a floor.

The document says public and private administrations providing a public service must observe the Cadre's principles and recommendations, which cover the referenced technical standards, and that it is instituted by décret n° 2020-209 of 18 March 2020; the decree text itself is not held, so the compulsion rests on this statement.
